taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Bellis perennis, plant_name_id 2922692 (Library 1.0 candidate r2).

growth_form.note: FNA vol. 20: a rhizomatous herb with a basal rosette and single heads on leafless peduncles.

growth.note: Grown three years, a small perennial that flowers from its first spring.

variants.note: One seed in the open: lawns and waste places (FNA).

allometry.note: FNA vol. 20: peduncles (3-)5-15(-20) cm; the middle, 10 cm, at three years.

traits.life_span.note: FNA vol. 20, genus Bellis: perennials (B. perennis).

traits.height_typical_m.note: FNA vol. 20, Bellis perennis: peduncles (3-)5-15(-20) cm, which carry the heads above the rosette.

traits.height_max_m.note: FNA vol. 20, Bellis perennis: peduncles to 20 cm.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: FNA vol. 20, genus Bellis: leaves basal, alternate in the rosette.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: FNA vol. 20, Bellis perennis: blades 6-40 mm long.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: FNA vol. 20, Bellis perennis: blades 4-20 mm wide.

traits.leaf_shape.note: FNA vol. 20, Bellis perennis: blades with attenuate bases and rounded apices on winged petioles: spatulate.

traits.leaf_margin.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2922692): crenate.

traits.leaf_apex.note: FNA vol. 20, Bellis perennis: apices rounded.

traits.perennation.note: FNA vol. 20, Bellis perennis: rhizomes short, erect.

traits.ray_length_m.note: FNA vol. 20, Bellis perennis: ray corollas 4-8(-11) mm.

traits.ray_colour.note: FNA vol. 20: rays white above, often pink-tinged beneath. Median of the white pixels in 12 flowering photographs (observations 114757428, 59910354, 64220079, 105854456, 103642455, 107314466, 261852618, 124619415, ...; batch pilot-asteraceae-2026-10-31d): sRGB [234, 233, 230].

traits.disc_colour.note: FNA vol. 20: disc corollas pale yellow. Median of the yellow pixels in 14 flowering photographs (batch pilot-asteraceae-2026-10-31d): sRGB [192, 171, 43].

traits.flowering_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2922692): March to October; FNA says spring to summer.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: FNA vol. 20, Bellis perennis: cypselae 1-2 mm.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2922692): April to October.

traits.cauline_leaves.note: FNA vol. 20, genus Bellis: perennials, scapiform; leaves basal (mostly), sometimes cauline and reduced in species outside the flora; B. perennis has leafless scapes from its rosette.

sources.title: Flora of North America vol. 20 (eFloras), drafted species facts of 2026-10-15, and iNaturalist photographs
